query:
SELECT t.id AS territory_id, t.code AS "territory_code!",
                  count(*) AS "open_count!"
           FROM signals s
           JOIN accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
           JOIN territories t ON t.id = a.territory_id
           WHERE s.status IN ('open', 'assigned')
           GROUP BY t.id, t.code
           ORDER BY t.code
